summary.intent: Coordinate parallel subagent workers resolving merge conflicts and getting CI green on several PRs (#323, #327, #347/#343, #367/#348/#349) in the caliper repo, verifying state on GitHub before reporting.
summary.outcome: PR #323 was merged with main, pushed, and fully green with 0 open findings. PR #327 was merged with main, had a test and docs fix pushed (605fb048), and all non-review checks pass, but Entire Gates and the final findings re-list were still pending. The other two workers were still running.

repo: Local branch names may differ from remote ones when a branch is checked out in another worktree (e.g. local mc323 pushed to measure/storybook-accuracy-headline), so push with `git push origin local:remote`.

The lint gate is `just lint doc-check machete typos`; clean-room verification runs in /tmp worktrees after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline` and covers Rust nextest, oracle vitest, Python unittest, the napi crate and the Vite plugin.
Entire review findings are listed with `entire trail finding list <trail> --project gh/orin-dx --freshness current --status open --json`; an empty list is not reliable until Entire Gates completes.
CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION (29) is the cache version to check for conflicts when merging main.
Main introduced a shared `in_node_modules` helper in crates/core/src/dependency_types.rs, replacing ad-hoc `contains("/node_modules/")` checks.

code.finding: In the `CollapseInheritedProps::All` arm of `collapses()`, the merge combined this PR's dependency/large logic with main's helper: `large && !crate::dependency_types::in_node_modules(file.as_str())`.

Main's new test `collapsing_all_leaves_a_node_modules_source_alone_whichever_separator_the_path_uses` called the old `collapses` signature. This was a semantic break git did not flag, fixed by calling `ctx.collapses(Utf8Path::new(file), "Props", 31, 1, &state)`.
Both sides added an import at the same spot (`import headline` and `import schema_version`); the conflict was resolved by keeping both.
The doc cited apps/oracle/src/layer-only.ts and a 'Layer-only props' section that don't exist on main. It was reworded to say they live on the `measure/layer-only-props` branch.

workflow: A clean textual merge can still break compilation, such as tests calling a changed signature, so run the lint gate after merging.
Subagent workers can loop and resend duplicate reports while waiting on CI; replying to them can trigger more duplicates.
Verify PR state on GitHub directly (`gh pr view --json state`) before pushing and before reporting, rather than relying on a worker's report.
CI runs can sit queued for a long time before starting.

friction: The #323/#327 worker repeatedly resent the same report while waiting on CI, and the coordinator's message to stop it caused further duplicate notices.
CI runs for #327 were queued for a long time, delaying verification.
Entire review findings showed 0 open until Entire Gates completed, making early status misleading.
